package.description: GPU monitoring tool for Windows - htop-like task monitor for NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs

en-US.description: GPU monitoring tool for Windows - htop-like task monitor for NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs
en-US.longDescription: NVTOP (Neat Videocard TOP) is a GPU monitoring tool for Windows that provides real-time information about GPU usage. Features multi-vendor GPU support (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel), per-process monitoring, color-coded utilization bars, and native Windows performance.
en-US.name: NVTOP
